description: This PHP source file manages the creation and output of PDF quotes within the vTiger CRM system. It initializes a QuotePDFController, loads quote record data, generates a PDF filename, and either saves or forces a download of the generated quote PDF.

classes.name: Vtiger_QuotePDFController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating and managing quote PDFs.

methods.name: loadRecord
methods.description: Loads quote record data into the PDF generation process.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs the generated PDF either as a file saved on the server or as a forced download.
